events.title: How Soon Is Now? — Bruce Reynolds Exhibition Opening
events.description: This is the opening of Bruce Reynolds' national touring exhibition, featuring works by the acclaimed Brisbane-based artist. The opening is a vibrant social atmosphere, and you can also join the artist for an engaging talk.

events.title: Noosa Arts Theatre Production (Title TBC)
events.description: Experience diverse, quality, and intimate theatre from the Noosa Arts Theatre's new production, running from May 21st to 31st. Check their website for the specific show title and exact session times.

events.title: DON'T CHANGE – Ultimate INXS Tribute
events.description: Enjoy a live tribute concert to INXS in a casual pub setting, perfect for music lovers who enjoy classic Australian rock. The atmosphere is intimate, offering a great night out for fans of live music.

events.title: Very Short Film Festival (VSFF) Screening
events.description: The touring Very Short Film Festival brings a curated selection of standout short films, each under five minutes, to the big screen. Genres include comedy, drama, and documentary; confirm the exact screening date on the event page.

events.title: Gourmay — Mary Valley Food & Producers Month
events.description: A month-long celebration of local food, producers, workshops, and farm trails highlighting the Mary Valley's finest flavours. Check the Gourmay website for specific workshops, tastings, and producer events happening this week for food-culture enthusiasts.

events.title: Heart Health Morning & Community Checks
events.location: UniSC Sunshine Coast campus, Sippy Downs
events.description: UniSC and Sunshine Coast University Hospital collaborate to offer practical, easy-to-understand heart health education and free cardiovascular health checks. Learn about research and care improvements in a community-focused morning.
